metadata.title: Fellows Portal, Refactored.
metadata.description: A real build reel: taking a single-tier Fellows Portal (one shared admin password, one growing dashboard file, free-text project matching) to a proper three-role system (fellow / admin / super-admin) via a two-boolean schema, one unified session model, and nav-level gating. Screen-capture OUTPUT beats are real recordings against the live dev app using existing dummy accounts.
metadata.note: DOUBLE-CHECK corrections logged in SOURCES.md: (1) the pre-refactor app was NOT 'just a login page' — fellow auth, profile dashboard, and report submission already existed (built 2026-04-04 by a different author + Claude Opus); what was missing was role tiering (a single shared ADMIN_PASSWORD, not per-user flags). (2) 'report upload' corrected to 'report submission' — reports are markdown text via a form, not file uploads.
